data.gender_notes: Bethanne is used as a unisex name in Christian naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: The name Bethanne is derived from the Hebrew words ‘bet’, meaning house, and ‘anah’, meaning God. This name was borne by Bethanne, a daughter of Eli in the Bible. The name signifies the house or dwelling place of God, and is a reminder of God's presence and protection. The name Bethanne carries the meaning “House of God” and is chosen by families in Christian traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Biblical tradition and is also used in English, Greek, Latin. Parents who choose Bethanne usually hope their child will grow to embody house of god and live with faith, good character and purpose.

in_latin.name: Bethanne

in_english.name: Bethanne
in_english.long_meaning: The name Bethanne originates from Hebrew roots, combining 'בַּיִת' (beth), meaning house or home, and 'אָנִי' (anne), meaning grace or favor. It signifies a dwelling place of God or a house of grace, reflecting divine presence and blessing. Historically, the name carries spiritual significance in Christian tradition, symbolizing a place of worship, prayer, and communion with God. In modern usage, Bethanne is associated with qualities of piety, gratitude, and devotion
